title: Smart Stock
desc: Restaurant inventory app built with a 4-person Agile team, replacing spreadsheet tracking with live stock levels, low-stock and expiry alerts, and waste trends.
tech: TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Flask API, JWT

title: JobMatch
desc:
Reads a résumé into a structured profile with the OpenAI API,
automatically retrying whenever the AI returns invalid data.
Rate limiting and caching keep it reliable at zero hosting cost.
Cuts tailoring and submitting an application from ~30 minutes to under one.
tech: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, OpenAI API, Zod

title: Fragments Microservice
desc:
Cloud file service on AWS: stores and converts text, JSON, and images
through a REST API, with Amazon Cognito auth scoping reads and writes by owner.
Least-privilege IAM roles reach S3 and DynamoDB, keeping credentials out of source control.
Dockerized, with a GitHub Actions pipeline that blocks failing builds from deploy.
tech: Node.js, Express, AWS (Cognito, IAM, DynamoDB, S3), Docker

title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
desc:
Trains a simulated self-driving car
using CNNs and reinforcement learning.

title: AI Emotion Detector
desc:
Lightweight CNN facial-emotion recognition
trained on FER2013, with a real-time labeled feed
and a growing sample corpus for training a
triplet-loss classifier against the cascade baseline.

title: Gaming Laptop Recommender
desc:
Automated scraper collecting live specs for 1,000+ gaming laptops
from major retailers, holding roughly 90% collection success as
those sites change, by using a separate configuration per retailer.
A chat front end recommends laptops by budget and intended use.
